'''Gungan Security Chief''' was a title among the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], and a being holding the position was responsible for security concerns. One [[Unidentified Gungan Security Chief|chief]] participated in a short duel with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during the [[Battle of the Sacred Place]] and just prior to the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].
